items.title: Braiins warns of Bitcoin mining attacks affecting over 1,000 sites
items.summary: Bitcoin mining pool operator Braiins warned that attackers are exploiting unsecured connections to hijack miners' computing power and potentially steal rewards.

items.title: Ethereum Foundation backs Keccak-256 to counter quantum, AI threats
items.summary: Ethlabs co-founder Julian Ma told Cointelegraph that AI poses a more immediate threat as Ethereum prepares for one of its biggest security overhauls since the Merge.

items.title: US inflation rises to 3.8% ahead of December Fed meeting, clouding crypto outlook
items.summary: US core inflation rose more than expected in October as markets anticipate a December interest rate hike, which could slow a crypto market recovery.

items.title: Bitcoin miners hit by hashrate hijacking attack exploiting unencrypted connections
items.summary: Braiins warns that an attacker is redirecting miners' compute power to steal bitcoin mining rewards.

items.title: Bitcoin falls below $58,000 as CoinShares' Butterfill sees 'tail end of the bear market'
items.summary: The crypto market cap fell to its lowest since September 2024 as stocks slid and U.S. inflation picked up.

items.title: Bitcoin has fallen so far that its original Rainbow Chart has run out of colors
items.summary: BlockchainCenter's November 25 snapshot put Bitcoin at $58,577 after an 8.6% weekly slide, while its two curves gave sharply different readings.

items.title: 'This time actually seems different': Crypto veterans brace for more pain as bitcoin tumbles
items.summary: Crypto sentiment is near rock bottom, but Galaxy sees room for a deeper slide and even longtime crypto bulls are wary of buying amid fears of AI and quantum computing.

items.title: Crypto Long & Short: Bitcoin investors can't keep ignoring Japan
items.summary: Yen-funded carry trades ran an estimated $250 billion before the August 2024 selloff, and the Bank of Japan's policy rate is now around 1.25%.
